conventions.indent: 0 = top level in the figure; 1 = part of the level-0 assembly above it; 2 = part of the level-1 item above it. Read from the description column x offset (+90/+108/+126 pt from the part-number column).
conventions.qty_per_assy: "Units per Assembly" column as printed. In this catalog the numbers are already per-engine totals (fig 8: 4 cylinders, 4 intake seats, 8 spark plug inserts, 16 rocker shaft bushings), so units_per_engine is NOT multiplied through the hierarchy. "AR" = as required.
conventions.units_per_engine: count used in the default configuration; units_per_engine_by_config gives every configuration. 0 = alternate not used in that configuration.
conventions.ref: figure callout number. Rows printed without an item number share the previous callout (alternates) and carry ref_inherited=true. Harness-bag lines carry bag_line instead.

codes.P: Lycoming proprietary part, listed for reference only
codes.V: Vendor prime manufacturer part (vendor_part_number holds the vendor number)
codes.*,**,***,♦: footnote markers, footnote text copied into notes

conventions.page: pdf = 1-based PDF page; catalog = printed "Page N" (figure section: catalog page = pdf page - 14)
conventions.is_hardware: fasteners and locking/sealing/plumbing small parts: screw, bolt, nut, washer, stud, pin, cotter pin, dowel, clamp, thread insert, plug, gasket, seal, seal ring, retaining ring, lockplate, clip, cable tie, fitting, spacer, baffle retainer/hook
conventions.dimensions: thread, diameter_in, length_in, inner/outer_diameter_in, thickness_in, pipe_size_in, head parsed from the nomenclature only when printed there. diameter_in for threaded parts = nominal major diameter.
